item.text: I found the current complexity point: the `PatternSearcher` interface and factory don’t buy us anything with only one implementation. I’m simplifying the codebase back down to a single public utility class, which removes indirection and makes the API easier to read and use.
I’m removing the now-unused abstraction files next. Once those are gone, the codebase will be back to a simple utility + demo + test layout instead of carrying dead indirection.
The simplification is done. I’m compiling and running the demo/test flow now to make sure the API collapse didn’t change behavior and that there are no stale references to the removed factory types.
